name: Oddamavadi Bridge
facts: Oddamavadi Bridge, a 250‑meter marvel, straddles the Valaichchenai Lagoon, linking the coastal town of Oddamavadi to the bustling district of Batticaloa on Sri Lanka's eastern coast.
The bridge boasts a dual‑purpose design: a historic British Ceylon truss section serves as a road‑rail corridor, while a modern twin‑lane span carries the A15 highway traffic.
Financed by Spain and the World Bank, the new 10.5‑meter‑wide bridge opened to traffic in 2015, dramatically reducing travel time between Batticaloa and Trincomalee.
